cmd:
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN= /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
D=/opt/trading-bot/classic
curl -sfH "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/classic_tl_robust.py" -o $D/classic_tl_robust.py
chown tbot:tbot $D/classic_tl_robust.py; cd $D; rm -f out_rob_4h.txt out_rob_1h.txt
nohup sudo -u tbot /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python classic_tl_robust.py 4h > out_rob_4h.txt 2>&1 &
nohup sudo -u tbot /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python classic_tl_robust.py 1h > out_rob_1h.txt 2>&1 &
sleep 5; echo started
